g.text: Negative binomial models, one per series; lines: 95 % intervals (autocorrelation-robust). Rain and snowfall are the day’s totals at Montréal-Trudeau (24 h).

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: A series has no mark where it has fewer than five such days (BIXI: April 15 to November 15 only). Snowfall of 10 cm or more is merged with 2 to 10 cm.
